tool_input.command:
cd /workspace
echo "capture probe" > /tmp/scratch/probe.txt
sleep 1 2>/dev/null || true
L=/tmp/scratch/hook_payloads.jsonl
if [ -f "$L" ]; then echo "CAPTURED $(wc -l < $L) events"; /usr/bin/python3 -c "
import json,sys
seen={}
for line in open('$L'):
    d=json.loads(line); seen.setdefault(d['argv'][0], d)
for k,v in seen.items(): print(k, sorted(v['payload']))
"; else echo "NO CAPTURE YET (settings not reloaded mid-session)"; fi
tool_input.description: Check whether the capture hook fired
